Class Line

java.lang.Object
Line
All Implemented Interfaces:
Geometry
class Line extends Object implements Geometry
Line class. A line extends infinitely in both directions. Now that I think about it, I probably could have extended from the vector class...
Author:
John McKeighen

    • scale

      @Deprecated(since="1.0", forRemoval=false) public void scale(float factor)
      Deprecated.
      Dilating each point in the line would scale only the y-intercept, which is not what I imagine people would use this function for. Use scaleSlope(float) to scale the slope.
